title: Quote of the day by Bill Miller: "Markets are all about expectations, and the critical question for investors is always, what is discounted?

title: How RBI could tackle a liquidity deluge triggered by dollar deposits
summary: The RBI’s special dollar deposit scheme attracted a massive $127.23 billion, pushing India’s banking system liquidity surplus to a record ₹9.70 trillion.
